    Creates a formatter that will print the key values in order of the passed in keys if they exist in percent encoding (RFC 3986 URI aka the format usually used in URI.getQuery()), preserving the null/empty-string distinction for a key whose value is null (LogFormatter.KeyValueNullStrategy.KEEP - most key values, e.g.
    LogFormatter.Builder
    LogFormatter.Builder.encodedKeyValues(List<String> keys, LogFormatter.KeyValueNullStrategy nullStrategy)
    Creates a formatter that will print the key values in order of the passed in keys if they exist in percent encoding (RFC 3986 URI aka the format usually used in URI.getQuery()), handling keys whose value is null (or simply absent - the two are indistinguishable, see LogFormatter.KeyValueNullStrategy) according to nullStrategy.

    LogFormatter.Builder
    LogFormatter.Builder.keyValue(String key, @Nullable String fallback)
    Creates a formatter that will print a single key's value, Logback/Log4j2 %X{key} style: just the raw value (or the fallback, or an empty string if neither is present) - no key prefix, no percent encoding.
    LogFormatter.Builder
    LogFormatter.Builder.keyValues()
    Creates a formatter that will print ALL of the key values the same way Logback's %X/%mdc does: comma-space separated key=value pairs with no surrounding braces (unlike Log4j2, which wraps the same pairs in {}), and no percent encoding.
    LogFormatter.Builder
    LogFormatter.Builder.keyValues(List<String> keys)
    Creates a formatter that will print the key values in order of the passed in keys if they exist, Logback %X style (see LogFormatter.Builder.keyValues() for the exact format).
